name: singlet_grn_multiome_egrn_inference
title: Multiome eRegulon inference (enhancer-driven GRN)
description: Infers enhancer-to-gene links, TF-to-region motif assignments and signed eRegulons from paired RNA and ATAC cells, then scores per-cell eRegulon activity. Use method pando by default (per-gene interaction GLM with FDR-adjusted p-values); scenic_plus adds motif enrichment. Requires paired cells, a peak-by-cell ATAC layer and a versioned motif database. Writes uns/egrn members and obsm/egrn_activity; do not use on unpaired data or to infer causal regulation.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: eRegulon method: pando (interaction GLM, default) or scenic_plus (boosted importance with motif enrichment).

layer.description: RNA count layer for expression; the method applies its own normalisation.

atac_layer.description: Peak-by-cell accessibility layer over the same cells as the RNA layer.

cell_type_key.description: obs key for cell-type labels; when present, fits run within each type.

motif_db.description: Versioned TF motif collection, for example a CIS-BP release. Required; sets the candidate TF-region pairs.

pando.description: Options used when method is pando.

extend_bp.description: Genomic window around each gene, in bp, within which candidate peaks are considered.

peak_cor.description: Minimum absolute peak-gene correlation to keep a peak; zero keeps every nonzero correlation.

tf_cor.description: Minimum absolute TF-gene correlation to keep a TF as a candidate regulator.

rsq_thresh.description: R-squared threshold for keeping a gene module.

min_genes_per_module.description: Minimum number of genes per module.

p_adjust.description: Multiple-testing adjustment for interaction p-values (p.adjust method).

scenic_plus.description: Options used when method is scenic_plus.

upstream_bp.description: Upstream bound of the region search space, in bp.

downstream_bp.description: Downstream bound of the region search space, in bp.

gbm_learning_rate.description: Learning rate of the boosted importance model.

gbm_n_estimators.description: Number of boosting stages in the importance model.

gbm_max_features.description: Fraction of features considered per split in the importance model.

ctx_nes_threshold.description: NES threshold for keeping an enriched motif.

ctx_rank_threshold.description: Top fraction of regions used in the recovery AUC.

top_n_per_gene.description: Number of top region-gene links kept per gene for eRegulon building.

seed.description: Seed for the boosted importance model (scenic_plus only; the pando path is deterministic).

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example uns/egrn/pando/eregulons. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact counts for completed runs: method, n_cell_types, n_region_gene_links, n_tf_region_pairs, n_eregulons. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
